description: Implementation of a Tun/Tap network device class for managing virtual network interfaces, including device initialization, configuration, and control functions.

classes.name: TunTapDevice
classes.description: A class managing a TUN/TAP network interface, providing methods for device setup, configuration, and control.

methods.name: TunTapDevice
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TunTapDevice with interface parameters and kernel interface.

methods.name: ~TunTapDevice
methods.description: Destructor that disables the device if not persistent and closes the device.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the device by opening and configuring the interface.

methods.name: GetFileDescriptor
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor for the device.

methods.name: OpenDevice
methods.description: Opens the device file and sets up the interface.

methods.name: ConfigureInterface
methods.description: Configures interface parameters such as MTU.

methods.name: NetdeviceIoctl
methods.description: Performs ioctl operations on the device socket.
